observation: Tracing beat drawing by a wide margin for this emblem: a traced artwork with the lettering lifted out and three live text layers scored 97.4-97.9/100, where hand-built shapes and fonts stopped at 79 and drawn glyphs plus poster_fit at 88.6. The words stay audited text. Two rough edges: (1) lift_text 'auto' also lifts small art of the text colour (leaves, shading), so the mashups needed per-area colours ({color, within}); (2) poster_fit takes about 110 s per emblem on 2 CPU cores (about 110 preview renders and compares of roughly a second each).
suggestion: Let poster_fit try the candidates of one round in parallel and stop a parameter early once both directions fail twice, and let lift_text skip shapes that are not on a line of similar shapes (a lone leaf has no neighbours), so 'auto' works without areas.
would_enable: A one-call recreate of any badge or logo with its words as live text, in about a minute instead of two.
